note: single-std::sort comparator recomputes the cached-class of both operands on every comparison; the bucket implementation replaces that with 2 partition passes + 3 short (count,key) sorts. On this cohort ~36.0% of nodes have no cached child at all, so the single-sort fast path is already dominated by (count,key) comparisons; bucket adds partition cost with little comparator savings.
